title: DIFFERENT BREEDS OF DAIRY CATTLE
text:
DIFFERENT BREEDS OF DAIRY CATTLE

Objectives:
1. To learn the characterization of dairy breeds.
2. To familiarize the different breeds of dairy cattle.

Characterization of Breeds:

Bos taurus
CHARACTERISTICS
➢ Widely distributed in temperate countries
➢ Horns are shorter and broad, generally polled
➢ Without humps, large body especially in the head and neck, broad rump
➢ Short legged
➢ Long productive period
➢ Susceptible to genetic diseases and parasites
➢ High nutritional requirements
➢ Highly developed milk production

Bos indicus
CHARACTERISTICS
➢ Widely distributed in tropical countries
➢ With horn, known for their humps, narrow body with sloping rump
➢ Long legged
➢ Shorter productive period
➢ Shows tolerance to diseases and parasites
➢ Heat resistant
➢ Low nutritional requirements
➢ Low milk production

facts: The learning objectives of the section are to learn the characterization of dairy breeds and to familiarize the different breeds of dairy cattle.
Bos taurus cattle are widely distributed in temperate countries.
Bos taurus have horns that are shorter and broad, and are generally polled.
Bos taurus lack humps, have a large body especially in the head and neck, and feature a broad rump.
Bos taurus cattle are short legged.
Bos taurus have a long productive period.
Bos taurus cattle are susceptible to genetic diseases and parasites.
Bos taurus cattle have high nutritional requirements.
Bos taurus cattle have highly developed milk production.
Bos indicus cattle are widely distributed in tropical countries.
Bos indicus have horns, are known for their humps, and have a narrow body with a sloping rump.
Bos indicus cattle are long legged.
Bos indicus have a shorter productive period compared to Bos taurus.
Bos indicus cattle show tolerance to diseases and parasites.
Bos indicus cattle are heat resistant.
Bos indicus cattle have low nutritional requirements.
Bos indicus cattle have low milk production.

questions.question: Which cattle species is characterized by being widely distributed in temperate countries, having no humps, and having highly developed milk production?
Which of the following physical characteristics is typical of Bos indicus cattle?

options.B: Short legged with generally polled heads
options.C: Known for prominent humps, long legs, and sloping rump
options.D: Large body especially in the head and neck without horns

questions.question: Which statement correctly compares the nutritional requirements of Bos taurus and Bos indicus?

options.A: Bos taurus has high nutritional requirements, whereas Bos indicus has low nutritional requirements.
options.B: Both Bos taurus and Bos indicus have identical high nutritional requirements.
options.C: Bos indicus requires higher nutrition due to heat stress in tropical regions.
options.D: Bos taurus has low nutritional requirements because of temperate grazing.

questions.question: Regarding disease and parasite tolerance, how does Bos taurus differ from Bos indicus?

options.A: Bos taurus is immune to all diseases, while Bos indicus is susceptible.
options.B: Bos taurus is susceptible to genetic diseases and parasites, while Bos indicus shows tolerance.
options.C: Both species have equal susceptibility to parasites.
options.D: Bos indicus is highly vulnerable to tropical parasites compared to Bos taurus.

questions.question: How do the productive periods of Bos taurus and Bos indicus compare?

options.A: Bos taurus has a shorter productive period than Bos indicus
options.B: Bos indicus has a long productive period, while Bos taurus is short
options.C: Bos taurus has a long productive period, whereas Bos indicus has a shorter productive period
options.D: Neither breed has a productive period exceeding two years

questions.question: Which environmental adaptation is explicitly listed as a characteristic of tropical Bos indicus cattle?
How are the horns of Bos taurus typically described in the breed characterization table?
Which of the following describes the leg length and body shape of Bos taurus compared to Bos indicus?

options.A: Bos taurus is short legged with broad rump; Bos indicus is long legged with sloping rump
options.B: Bos taurus is long legged with narrow body; Bos indicus is short legged with broad body
options.C: Both breeds have identically long legs and narrow chests
options.D: Bos taurus has sloping rump with long legs; Bos indicus has broad rump with short legs
